source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: In the opposing player's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit finishes shooting, this unit may perform a surge move, moving up to D6+2", provided this model lost at least one wound to those attacks.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.condition: this model lost one or more wounds from those attacks
